reuse.why: Follows the existing ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked precondition pattern with a sibling guard; does not fold the check into a single shared link-precondition helper, but nothing existing is re-implemented.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once; only the one-line guard call is repeated in each of the six provider link functions, mirroring the existing guard call.

placement.why: The guard sits next to the existing link precondition in accounts/app.ts and runs before any bank lookup or write.

scope.why: Focused on the six link paths plus a test; the only unrelated churn is reformatting the goCardless ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked call.

maintainability.why: Clear named guard reused everywhere; a new provider must remember two guard calls instead of one combined precondition.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link functions call the new guard alongside the existing ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the closed check exists only in ensureTargetAccountIsOpen.
